title: Staffing route catalog
description: Top-level catalog of dispatch routes. Route identity is the tuple (model, effort, harness, channel). This schema defines shape only; it encodes no selection, ranking, probability, or pricing decisions. Dispatch templates are data and are never executed by validation.

route_id.description: Stable string identifier for this route.

model.description: Model identifier; part of the route identity tuple.

effort.description: Model effort dial; part of the route identity tuple. Null only where the harness has no effort dial.

harness.description: Harness identifier; part of the route identity tuple.

channel.description: Channel identifier; part of the route identity tuple. Must match a channel_id in the channel catalog.

dispatch_template.description: Dispatch template as data. Never executed by validation.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this route: active (dispatchable), unpriced (not yet evaluated for cost), or retired (no longer dispatched).

status_reason.description: Sourced explanation required only when status is unpriced; must contain at least one non-whitespace character. Optional for active and retired routes, whose status is self-explanatory.

family.description: Optional nonempty author/candidate independence comparison label only (Chief round 15). When present, the reviewer/judge independence check compares this value verbatim instead of the model-vendor-prefix fallback derived from model; it exists solely to join an author route to comparable candidates for the exclusion check, never to map class metadata to a preferred model or route and never as a preference, ranking, selection, probability, or ladder input (D206). Routes may omit it and continue using the model-vendor-prefix fallback.
